statement.p: If b > 1, what is the horizontal asymptote of y=ab^t as t \rightarrow - \infty?
Enter NONE if there is no horizontal asymptote (that is, if the graph goes to \pm \infty as t \rightarrow - \infty). Otherwise enter an equation for the line that is the horizontal asymptote.

static.solution:
SOLUTION
As t \rightarrow - \infty the graph gets closer and closer to the t-axis, so there is a horizontal asymptote at y = 0.
